name: 55403 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55403 (Minneapolis) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55403 (Minneapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
